reason: A startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report can't sit inline in our order path. It would fail vendor review at the risk committee before anyone asked about price, and even a free pilot means a reference and an LOI I'm not putting my name on yet.
objection: It's another hop in front of every agent trade, so more latency and a new point of failure, run by a company that can't yet show me an audit, references or uptime history. If the proxy goes down or fails closed at the open, that's my incident, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II plus two referenceable regulated brokers running it inline in production with published latency and failover numbers. Until then, at most a shadow-mode trial off the trade path.
